messages:
marta: RCA published for the degraded routing incident earlier today. Link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2112223334-handoff 

marta: TL;DR — root cause was a bad routing rule that caused 30% of traffic to hit a non-healthy pool during a scale event. We recovered with rollback + warm pool activation.

marta: Action items summarized below and owners assigned. Please ack if you own something. Checkpoint meeting Thurs 10:00 PT.

sasha: ack — I'll take owner on A1 (validate routing rule tests + add CI guardrails). ETA: 2026-04-02

devon: taking A2 (postmortem for KB cache eviction behavior). Will pair with engops. ETA: 2026-04-09

priya: I'll handle A3 (deploy playbook updates + runbook edits). Adding steps for warm pool activation and fallback. ETA: 2026-04-05 :white_check_mark:

alex: noted, will add query-level metrics to dashboard (A4). Putting a draft dashboard on grafana: https://grafana.redwood/team/serving/dashboards/route-coverage

engops: We'll schedule a canary window and add a policy to prevent >20% routing shifting in 5m without manual approval (A5).

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-4123. Timeline and logs attached in the incident doc.

sasha: quick log snippet that helped identify misroute:
```
2026-03-18T07:12:03Z WARN routing.cpp:143 rule_evaluate timeout=0.02s rule_id=\"route-v2\" pool=\"warm-pool\" selected=false
2026-03-18T07:12:03Z ERROR loadbalancer.cpp:88 pick_target returned null (no healthy nodes)
```

marta: Priorities for Thurs checkpoint: 1) confirm CI test added & passing, 2) rollout plan for policy guard, 3) monitor windows and rollback criteria.

devon: FYI — customer-facing impact was low (few 5xx spikes for 12m). CS notified.

priya: Added a short summary for execs to the RCA page under "Impact & Customer Communication".

alex: Will set alert thresholds so we get paged earlier if route coverage drops below 80% for >2m.

engops: Confirmed canary window scheduled for Fri 09:00 PT. ops lead assigned: devon.

marta: Owners, please drop short status updates in this thread by EOD Wednesday so we can bake those into the checkpoint agenda. Thanks everyone :pray:

sasha: Will post CI PR link by EOD.

devon: Pairing with engops tomorrow to scope A2.

priya: Runbook PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/582

marta: Closing note: good job on quick recovery. Postmortem page includes timeline, RCA, and an owner matrix. We'll reconvene at Thurs checkpoint to finalize dates and close items.
